name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: generate_marketing_copy
prompts.template: Generate a persuasive marketing copy targeting {target_audience} aimed at achieving {marketing_goal} with tone and style {content_parameters}.
prompts.use_case: Enhancing website conversion rates through AI-generated CRO tactics

prompts.name: seo_strategy_suggestion
prompts.template: Provide SEO recommendations to improve ranking for keywords related to {marketing_goal} targeting {target_audience}.
prompts.use_case: Creating SEO-optimized content for improved organic search performance

prompts.name: growth_analysis_report
prompts.template: Analyze the following analytics data and create a growth report with actionable insights: {analytics_data}.
prompts.use_case: Generating compelling marketing copy tailored to specific demographics

prompts.name: conversion_rate_optimization_plan
prompts.template: Develop a conversion rate optimization strategy based on current data and focus on the goal: {marketing_goal}.
prompts.use_case: Performing growth engineering analysis to identify scalable opportunities
